cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your message ends 'take care'. Please don't call that casual. It was the first phrase in my last breakup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You have a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how it starts: they get you healthy enough to leave. Please read the sequence, not just this one message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring you soup tonight. I want to look after you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the final kindness. Bring it in your own saucepan, please, not a tub you can abandon. We should at least be precise about what you're returning for.

reason: Make A's supposedly expert sequence-reading convert B's illness care into feared finality and direct the soup delivery around expected abandonment.
